checks.rationale: ranking power; 0.53 is a common floor but is only meaningful if it maps to more edge per trade than the spread
an interval straddling 0.50 means the ranking is not distinguishable from a coin flip
mean gap between claimed and observed probability; above this the headline 'probability of profit' cannot be sized against
beating the thing you could have simply bought, net of costs
positive risk-adjusted return after realistic costs
a return that needs more than a quarter of the account to stay invested is not deployable at any size
gross edge per unit turnover must exceed the 15.00% round trip; this is the binding economic constraint and it is not a round number

statistical_power.note: With this many independent bars a 0.53 AUC is comfortably resolvable, so failing it is informative rather than a power problem. The binding limits are economic and the length of the P&L record, not the size of the sample.
